title: ActorProfileV1
description: The authenticated actor's own profile, returned by GET /api/v1/me. Document 10 section 5 requires that this never returns the full authorization ruleset — only enough for the client to choose a mode and render navigation.

actor_id.description: Actor identifier, derived from the authenticated token. Never accepted from the request body.

actor_type.description: Actor type. Mirrors eldercare_ai.actor_type_enum. There is no LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE member — legal representation is a care relationship, not an actor type (document 06 section 4.1).

tenant_id.description: Tenant the actor is acting within. Derived from the token, never from client input.

role.description: Role the actor is acting as for this request.

elder_id.description: The actor's unique active elder profile when actor_type is ELDER; null or omitted for non-elder actors.

care_unit_ids.description: Care units the actor actively belongs to within the tenant. Empty for actors with no care-unit-scoped membership.
